user.title: Cattle Sprayer Mesh
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your house MeshCore gateway. One gateway image supports Wi‑Fi, USB, and Bluetooth — pick how HA should talk to it.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi (TCP)
wifi.description: Gateway SoftAP CattleSprayer-GW-xxxx → http://192.168.4.1/ → home Wi‑Fi. Then enter the gateway IP (TCP 5000) and the sprayer SoftAP pairing card.

data_description.host: From the gateway status page or your router
data_description.pairing: Sprayer SoftAP → Network → MeshCore → Add to home

usb.title: USB
usb.description:
Plug the gateway into this Home Assistant box. Paste the SoftAP pairing card.

USB ports found: {ports}

ble.title: Bluetooth
ble.description: Needs a Bluetooth adapter on the Home Assistant host (not an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy). Gateway advertises as MeshCore-… with PIN 123456. Leave address blank to scan.

data_description.ble_address: e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF — blank = scan for MeshCore-

error.invalid_pairing: That pairing card could not be read. Copy the full JSON from SoftAP (needs a 32-hex secret).
error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to the gateway. Check Wi‑Fi IP:5000, USB path, or BLE address/PIN 123456 (and that nothing else owns the link).

abort.already_configured: This companion is already set up
